name: Gigantes Plaki Greek Baked Beans with Feta and Bread

components.name: Gigantes Plaki

ingredients.name: Canned butter beans drained and rinsed

steps: Heat oven to 190 C and choose a covered oven-safe skillet.
Cook onion, carrot and celery in measured olive oil over medium heat 6-8 minutes; add garlic.
Add tomatoes, water, dried herbs and drained cooked butter beans; simmer 5 minutes to start sauce thickening.
Transfer skillet to the preheated oven, uncovered, for 25-35 minutes until the tomato sauce is thick and beans tender.
Freeze beans and sauce without fresh cheese topping if possible; feta may be added when reheating.

components.name: Wholegrain Bread
steps: Top with feta and parsley after baking, and serve with one measured slice of wholegrain bread per portion.
